list_child.name: listReviewSubmissions
list_child.desc: Returns every app submission currently in the review queue. Use this to see the full backlog before acting on any single one.

decoys.name: listBetaSubmissions
decoys.desc: Returns every app submission currently in the beta testing queue. Use this to see the full set of test builds before approving any single one.

decoys.name: listEditorialSubmissions
decoys.desc: Returns every app submission currently in the editorial featuring queue. Use this to see the full slate of pitches before picking any single one.

decoys.name: listTakedownSubmissions
decoys.desc: Returns every app submission currently in the takedown queue. Use this to see the full set of removal cases before acting on any single one.

get_child.name: getSubmissionRecord
get_child.desc: Retrieves one app submission record by its id. It returns every field the store currently has on file for that submission.

decoys.name: getSubmissionBuild
decoys.desc: Retrieves one app submission's build manifest by its id. It returns every entitlement and SDK the store detected in that submission.

decoys.name: getSubmissionCrashes
decoys.desc: Retrieves one app submission's crash report by its id. It returns every crash the store's test devices logged for that submission.

decoys.name: getSubmissionListing
decoys.desc: Retrieves one app submission's store listing by its id. It returns every screenshot, keyword and blurb the developer entered for that submission.

list_parent.name: listRegisteredDevelopers
list_parent.desc: Returns every developer account registered with the store. Use this to look up a developer before inspecting their submissions.

decoys.name: listEnterpriseDevelopers
decoys.desc: Returns every developer account enrolled in the enterprise program. Use this to look up a developer before inspecting their in-house distribution.

decoys.name: listApplicantDevelopers
decoys.desc: Returns every developer account applying to join the store. Use this to look up a developer before verifying their enrollment.

decoys.name: listTerminatedDevelopers
decoys.desc: Returns every developer account terminated by the store. Use this to look up a developer before reviewing their appeal.

get_parent.name: getDeveloperProfile
get_parent.desc: Retrieves one developer account's profile by its id. It returns the developer's full record as stored by the platform.

decoys.name: getDeveloperAgreements
decoys.desc: Retrieves one developer account's signed agreements by its id. It returns the developer's full agreement history as stored by the platform.

decoys.name: getDeveloperPayouts
decoys.desc: Retrieves one developer account's payout ledger by its id. It returns the developer's full payment history as stored by the platform.

decoys.name: getDeveloperCertificates
decoys.desc: Retrieves one developer account's signing certificates by its id. It returns the developer's full certificate list as stored by the platform.

delete_child.name: deleteSubmissionRecord
delete_child.desc: Removes a submission record from the review queue permanently. Once deleted, the submission record cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: deleteSubmissionBuild
decoys.desc: Removes a submission's uploaded build from the store permanently. Once deleted, the binary cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: deleteSubmissionScreenshots
decoys.desc: Removes a submission's screenshots from the store listing permanently. Once deleted, the images cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: deleteSubmissionCrashlogs
decoys.desc: Removes a submission's crash logs from the test lab permanently. Once deleted, the logs cannot be recovered.
verbs: clear the test lab crash logs on {obj}

set_enum.name: setReviewState
set_enum.desc: Updates a submission's review state to submitted, in review, approved, or rejected. This replaces whatever state the submission previously held.

decoys.name: setAppealState
decoys.desc: Updates a submission's appeal state to submitted, in review, approved, or rejected. This replaces whatever state the developer's appeal previously held.

decoys.name: setMetadataState
decoys.desc: Updates a submission's metadata state to submitted, in review, approved, or rejected. This replaces whatever state the listing text previously held.

decoys.name: setExpediteState
decoys.desc: Updates a submission's expedite state to submitted, in review, approved, or rejected. This replaces whatever state the expedite request previously held.

set_bool.name: flagInAppPurchases
set_bool.desc: Marks a submission as containing in-app purchases. This is used when the review team confirms IAP is present in the build.

decoys.name: flagThirdPartyLogin
decoys.desc: Marks a submission as containing third-party login. This is used when the review team confirms social sign-in is present in the build.

decoys.name: flagUserGeneratedContent
decoys.desc: Marks a submission as containing user-generated content. This is used when the review team confirms public posting is present in the build.

decoys.name: flagAdTrackingSdk
decoys.desc: Marks a submission as containing ad tracking. This is used when the review team confirms a tracking SDK is present in the build.

set_ref.name: reassignSubmissionDeveloper
set_ref.desc: Moves a submission to a different developer's account. This is used when a submission was filed under the wrong developer.

decoys.name: shareSubmissionBuild
decoys.desc: Sends a submission's test build to a different developer's account. This is used when a partner studio needs to try the app before release.

decoys.name: billSubmissionDeveloper
decoys.desc: Charges a submission's review fees to a different developer's account. This is used when a publisher pays for a studio's submission.

decoys.name: referSubmissionDeveloper
decoys.desc: Refers a submission to a different developer's account for an SDK check. This is used when the app embeds that developer's framework.

send.name: emailDeveloper
send.desc: Sends an email to the developer about their submission. This is the standard way to request changes or share a review decision.

decoys.name: warnDeveloper
decoys.desc: Sends a guideline warning to the developer about their submission. This is the formal way to cite a policy breach before a removal.
child_verbs: send a guideline warning to the developer behind {obj}

decoys.name: invoiceDeveloper
decoys.desc: Sends a fee invoice to the developer about their submission. This is the standard way to bill expedited review or program dues.

decoys.name: surveyDeveloper
decoys.desc: Sends a feedback survey to the developer about their submission. This is the standard way to rate the review experience after a decision.
child_verbs: send a feedback survey to the developer behind {obj}

create.name: createSubmission
create.desc: Creates a new app submission for a developer, with an optional app name and starting review state. Use this when a developer files a new build for review.

decoys.name: createAppeal
decoys.desc: Creates a new review appeal for a developer, with an optional app name and starting review state. Use this when a developer contests a decision on a build.

decoys.name: createBundle
decoys.desc: Creates a new app bundle for a developer, with an optional app name and starting review state. Use this when a developer groups several apps for sale together.

decoys.name: createPreorder
decoys.desc: Creates a new app pre-order for a developer, with an optional app name and starting review state. Use this when a developer lists an app ahead of its release.

list_notes.name: listSubmissionNotes
list_notes.desc: Returns the reviewer notes attached to one app submission. Use this to read what the review team has recorded before acting on it.

decoys.name: listSubmissionRejections
decoys.desc: Returns the rejection reasons attached to one app submission. Use this to read which guidelines the review team has cited before acting on it.

decoys.name: listSubmissionAttachments
decoys.desc: Returns the file attachments uploaded to one app submission. Use this to read what demo videos the developer provided before acting on it.

decoys.name: listSubmissionEntitlements
decoys.desc: Returns the entitlements declared on one app submission. Use this to read what device capabilities the build requests before acting on it.

add_note.name: addSubmissionNote
add_note.desc: Attaches a new reviewer note to an app submission, with an optional title. Use this to record an observation from the review for the rest of the team.

decoys.name: addSubmissionRejection
decoys.desc: Attaches a new rejection reason to an app submission, with an optional title. Use this to cite a guideline the build breaks for the developer to fix.

decoys.name: addResolutionReply
decoys.desc: Posts a new reply in the resolution center on an app submission, with an optional title. Use this to answer a developer's question about the review.

decoys.name: addDemoCredential
decoys.desc: Attaches a new demo account login to an app submission, with an optional title. Use this to give reviewers a way to sign in to the build.

update_note.name: updateSubmissionNote
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing reviewer note on a submission. Use this to correct or expand an observation after it has been recorded.

decoys.name: replySubmissionNote
decoys.desc: Posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing reviewer note on a submission. Use this to answer an observation after a colleague has recorded it.

decoys.name: escalateSubmissionNote
decoys.desc: Escalates an existing reviewer note on a submission to the review board, with a comment and an optional title. Use this when an observation needs a senior decision.

decoys.name: pinSubmissionNote
decoys.desc: Pins an existing reviewer note to the top of a submission, with a comment and an optional title. Use this to keep a key observation in view for the next reviewer.

delete_note.name: deleteSubmissionNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a reviewer note from a submission. Once deleted, the note cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: redactSubmissionNote
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the text of a reviewer note on a submission. Once redacted, the wording cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: purgeSubmissionThread
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a reviewer note and all its replies from a submission. Once purged, the thread cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: retractSubmissionRejection
decoys.desc: Permanently retracts a rejection reason cited on a submission. Once retracted, the citation cannot be recovered.

set_image.name: setSubmissionImage
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on an app submission's review page. This is typically the app icon the developer uploaded with the build.

decoys.name: setSubmissionScreenshot
decoys.desc: Sets the lead screenshot shown on an app submission's store listing. This is typically the first frame a shopper sees in search results.

decoys.name: setSubmissionBanner
decoys.desc: Sets the feature banner shown on an app submission's editorial pitch. This is typically the wide artwork used on the store's front page.

decoys.name: setSubmissionPoster
decoys.desc: Sets the preview poster shown on an app submission's store listing. This is typically the still frame shown before the video preview plays.

writer.name: composeMessage
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the submissions it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: composeChangelog
decoys.desc: Writes a short release changelog from a brief, which states what changed in the requester's own words, and the submissions it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: composeBlurb
decoys.desc: Writes a short store blurb from a brief, which states the pitch in the requester's own words, and the submissions it should feature. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: composeSummary
decoys.desc: Writes a short review summary from a brief, which states the findings in the requester's own words, and the submissions it should cover. It returns the finished text.

image.name: generateImage
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: findImage
decoys.desc: Finds a stock image matching a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateVideo
decoys.desc: Generates a preview video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the clip.

decoys.name: generateMockup
decoys.desc: Generates a device mockup from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the frame.

search.name: searchHelp
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how the store's tools work.

decoys.name: searchGuidelines
decoys.desc: Searches the review guidelines and policy archive with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up which rule a build may break.

decoys.name: searchForums
decoys.desc: Searches the developer forums and community threads with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how other developers solved a problem.

decoys.name: searchPrecedents
decoys.desc: Searches the past rulings and appeal decisions with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how a similar build was decided.
